founder.description: Heeft elk onderdeel van AI Educademy van nul af aan ontworpen en gebouwd. de architectuur, het curriculum, de meertalige infrastructuur en de open-source tools. Meer dan vijftien jaar grote systemen gebouwd bij JP Morgan, Sky en Marks & Spencer in Azië en Europa. Die wereldwijde ervaring maakte één ding duidelijk: taal mag nooit een barrière zijn voor leren.

about.title: Over AI Educademy
about.missionText: AI-onderwijs voor elke student, ongeacht taal, achtergrond of ervaring.
about.storyText1: Ik ben Ramesh Reddy Adutla. de oprichter, ontwerper en enige ingenieur achter AI Educademy. Met 15 jaar aan het bouwen van grootschalige gedistribueerde systemen bij JP Morgan, Sky en Marks & Spencer in Azië en Europa, heb ik mijn carrière besteed aan het snijvlak van technologie en echte impact.
about.storyText2: AI gaat elke sector veranderen. Toch blijft het beste AI-onderwijs opgesloten achter dure instellingen in een handvol landen. Die kloof is niet alleen oneerlijk, het is een enorme verspilling van potentieel.
about.storyText3: Ik heb AI Educademy bedacht en het volledig van nul af aan gebouwd. de architectuur, het curriculum, de meertalige infrastructuur, de open-source tools, elke regel code. Wat begon als avonden en weekenden is uitgegroeid tot een volledig gratis platform voor leerlingen in 11 talen op 6 continenten.
about.storyText4: Werken in meerdere landen waar Engels niet de eerste taal is maakte één ding duidelijk: taal mag nooit een barrière zijn om te leren. Ik spreek Engels, Frans en Telugu, dus een meertalig platform bouwen voelde als de logische stap.

ai-seeds.title: AI Seeds
ai-seeds.subtitle: AI literacy for the real world
ai-seeds.description: Build a clear mental model of modern AI, from training data and neural networks to generative tools, limitations, safety, and the choices people make around them.
ai-seeds.audience: Curious beginners, leaders, students, and career changers
ai-seeds.prerequisites: None. Just curiosity and a willingness to question the hype.
topics: Human judgement in an AI world
outcomes: Explain how modern AI systems learn and generate outputs
Choose AI tools with clear expectations and boundaries
Spot common reliability, bias, privacy, and safety risks
Complete a guided AI experiment and reflect on its limits
ai-seeds.homeDesc: AI literacy for the real world

ai-sprouts.title: AI Sprouts
ai-sprouts.subtitle: The foundations behind intelligent systems
ai-sprouts.description: Understand the building blocks behind modern AI: datasets, features, embeddings, neural networks, transformers, evaluation, and the practical trade-offs that shape model behaviour.
ai-sprouts.audience: Learners ready to move from AI literacy into technical understanding
ai-sprouts.prerequisites: AI Seeds or equivalent practical AI awareness
outcomes: Trace the path from data to model output
Explain embeddings, tokenisation, and transformer intuition
Select useful evaluation metrics for an AI task
Diagnose overfitting, bias, and data-quality failures

ai-branches.title: AI Branches
ai-branches.subtitle: Build with today’s AI capabilities
ai-branches.description: Move from concepts to applications. Work across text, vision, speech, and multimodal systems while learning where APIs, open models, structured outputs, and human review fit.
ai-branches.audience: Learners who want to build useful AI features
outcomes: Build a small multimodal AI feature
Choose between prompting, retrieval, and fine-tuning
Design clear input and output contracts for model calls
Explain failure modes to non-technical stakeholders

ai-canopy.title: AI Canopy
ai-canopy.subtitle: Engineer reliable GenAI systems
ai-canopy.description: Design production-minded LLM applications with retrieval, tool use, agent workflows, MCP, evaluation, guardrails, and observability. Learn to optimise for quality, latency, safety, and cost.
ai-canopy.audience: Developers and technical practitioners building AI applications
ai-canopy.prerequisites: AI Branches plus basic Python or TypeScript
topics: Tool calling, MCP, and agent workflows
outcomes: Build a grounded RAG assistant with citations
Design a safe tool-using agent with explicit boundaries
Create regression evaluations for quality and tool behaviour
Instrument an AI feature for latency, cost, and failure analysis

ai-forest.title: AI Forest
ai-forest.subtitle: Ship AI products responsibly
ai-forest.description: Bring the full lifecycle together: product discovery, architecture, data governance, model and vendor choices, deployment, monitoring, incident response, regulation, and continuous improvement.
ai-forest.audience: Senior builders, product engineers, technical leaders, and founders
ai-forest.prerequisites: AI Canopy or equivalent production AI experience
outcomes: Create a production AI delivery plan with measurable outcomes
Threat-model an AI system and define control points
Build a release and monitoring strategy for model change
Make defensible trade-offs across quality, cost, speed, and risk

ai-sketch.title: AI Sketch
ai-sketch.subtitle: Engineering foundations for AI builders
ai-sketch.description: Strengthen the programming, data structures, testing, and complexity fundamentals that make AI systems understandable, efficient, and maintainable.
ai-sketch.audience: Developers beginning AI engineering or interview preparation
ai-sketch.prerequisites: Basic programming in Python, JavaScript, Java, or another language
outcomes: Choose data structures deliberately
Explain time and space trade-offs
Write testable solutions under constraints
Connect algorithms to real AI application workloads

ai-chisel.title: AI Chisel
ai-chisel.subtitle: Patterns for solving harder problems
ai-chisel.description: Practise the algorithmic patterns that recur in production services, search, recommendation, data processing, and technical interviews.
ai-chisel.prerequisites: AI Sketch or equivalent data-structure knowledge
outcomes: Recognise and apply reusable problem-solving patterns
Prove correctness and analyse complexity
Choose practical optimisations without premature complexity
Communicate a solution clearly under pressure

ai-craft.title: AI Craft
ai-craft.subtitle: Design systems that scale AI
ai-craft.description: Learn system design for modern AI products: model gateways, retrieval services, async workloads, streaming, caches, rate limits, tenancy, and resilient APIs.
ai-craft.audience: Mid-to-senior engineers designing distributed AI systems
ai-craft.prerequisites: Comfort with APIs, databases, and distributed-system basics
outcomes: Produce a clear architecture with justified trade-offs
Design for failure, scale, and operational visibility
Estimate AI cost and capacity before implementation
Defend an AI system design in a technical review

ai-polish.title: AI Polish
ai-polish.subtitle: Communicate and lead in the AI era
ai-polish.description: Turn strong engineering into visible impact through technical communication, decision records, stakeholder alignment, responsible leadership, and AI-aware career storytelling.
ai-polish.audience: Engineers moving into senior, lead, or AI-focused roles
outcomes: Explain complex AI trade-offs to different audiences
Build evidence-based leadership stories
Lead decisions without hiding uncertainty
Position engineering impact clearly and credibly
ai-polish.homeDesc: Communicate and lead in the AI era

ai-masterpiece.title: AI Masterpiece
ai-masterpiece.subtitle: Your production AI capstone
ai-masterpiece.description: Design, build, evaluate, and present an end-to-end AI product. Combine retrieval or tool use with security, tests, observability, a runbook, and a credible product case.
ai-masterpiece.audience: Engineers ready to demonstrate production AI capability
ai-masterpiece.prerequisites: AI Canopy plus AI Craft, or equivalent experience
topics: Launch review and portfolio case study
outcomes: Ship a portfolio-ready AI system design and prototype
Demonstrate evaluation beyond a happy-path demo
Document risk, operations, and rollback decisions
Present technical work with clear business and user value

ai-launchpad.title: Interview Startplatform
ai-launchpad.subtitle: Navigate the AI engineering job market
ai-launchpad.description: Build a focused search strategy for AI-era roles: understand role families, read job descriptions, map your evidence, and prepare a realistic learning and application plan.
ai-launchpad.audience: People starting or redirecting an AI-focused career
outcomes: Choose target roles based on evidence and strengths
Turn job descriptions into a practical study plan
Build a credible project and application portfolio
Track progress without chasing every new tool
ai-launchpad.homeDesc: Navigate the AI engineering job market

ai-behavioral.title: Gedragsinterview Meesterschap
ai-behavioral.subtitle: Tell the story of how you create impact
ai-behavioral.description: Prepare concise, honest stories about ambiguity, delivery, failure, influence, conflict, and responsible AI decisions using evidence rather than rehearsed slogans.
ai-behavioral.audience: Engineers preparing for behavioural and leadership interviews
outcomes: Build a reusable story bank
Answer with context, action, and measurable outcome
Show judgement when technology and people trade-offs collide
Adapt one experience to different question styles
ai-behavioral.homeDesc: Tell the story of how you create impact

ai-technical.title: Technische Interviews
ai-technical.subtitle: Solve, design, and communicate under pressure
ai-technical.description: Practise coding, API, debugging, system design, and AI application questions with a repeatable method for clarifying requirements and defending trade-offs.
ai-technical.audience: Software engineers preparing for technical interviews
outcomes: Solve problems with a repeatable framework
Design reliable AI-enabled services
Debug systematically instead of guessing
Communicate assumptions and trade-offs clearly
ai-technical.homeDesc: Solve, design, and communicate under pressure

ai-ml-interview.title: AI- & ML-interviews
ai-ml-interview.subtitle: Prepare for modern ML and GenAI interviews
ai-ml-interview.description: Cover model selection, experimentation, ML system design, RAG and agent evaluation, data quality, MLOps, safety, and the trade-offs interviewers expect you to articulate.
ai-ml-interview.audience: Engineers targeting ML, applied AI, or AI platform roles
ai-ml-interview.prerequisites: AI foundations plus basic statistics and Python
outcomes: Design an ML or GenAI system end to end
Choose metrics that match user and business outcomes
Explain deployment and monitoring trade-offs
Handle safety and failure-mode questions with confidence
ai-ml-interview.homeDesc: Prepare for modern ML and GenAI interviews

ai-offer.title: Aanbod & verder
ai-offer.subtitle: Make a confident, informed next move
ai-offer.description: Evaluate AI-era roles and offers with a practical framework covering scope, learning, leadership, compensation, risk, working patterns, and your first 90 days.
ai-offer.audience: Candidates comparing offers or planning their next career step
ai-offer.prerequisites: An active search, interview process, or offer
outcomes: Compare offers beyond headline salary
Ask sharper questions about AI strategy and engineering quality
Negotiate from evidence without burning trust
Plan a strong first 90 days
ai-offer.homeDesc: Make a confident, informed next move

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AI Educademy. from getting started to going deep.
faq.a1: AI Educademy is a free, open-source platform for learning Artificial Intelligence. We offer structured programs, interactive lessons, and hands-on lab experiments to help anyone. regardless of background. understand and apply AI concepts.
faq.a2: Elke academie bij AI Educademy begint met een gratis eerste les, zodat je het kunt uitproberen voordat je je vastlegt. Pro ontgrendelt elke overige les, academie, track, certificaat en premium functie met maandelijkse, jaarlijkse of levenslange toegang.
faq.a3: AI Educademy was built with the mission of making AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere. The project is open-source and community-driven, welcoming contributions from developers, educators, and learners worldwide.
faq.a4: We offer two learning paths: the AI Learning Path (including AI Seeds for absolute beginners, AI Foundations, and more advanced programs) and the Craft Engineering Path for those interested in building AI-powered software. Each path has multiple programs with dozens of structured lessons.
faq.q5: How long does it take to complete a program?
faq.a5: It depends on the program and your pace. Beginner programs like AI Seeds can be completed in a few hours of focused study. More advanced programs may take several weeks. There are no deadlines. you learn entirely at your own pace.
faq.q6: What skill level do I need to start?
faq.a6: No prior experience is needed for beginner programs. AI Seeds and other introductory programs start from absolute zero. no math, no coding, no technical background required. Just curiosity.
faq.q7: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.a7: Not to start! Our introductory programs require zero coding knowledge. As you progress through the paths, you'll be gently introduced to relevant concepts and tools. but the emphasis is always on understanding AI deeply, not memorising syntax.
faq.a8: For beginner programs: none at all. For intermediate and advanced programs, it helps to have completed earlier programs in the path, but it's not strictly required. Jump in wherever feels right for you.
faq.q9: What languages is the content available in?
faq.a9: AI Educademy is available in 9 languages: English, French, Dutch, Hindi, Telugu, Spanish, Portuguese, German, and Chinese. All content is thoughtfully translated. not machine-generated. so the experience feels natural in your language.
faq.a10: Yes! Use the language switcher in the navigation bar to change the platform language at any time. Your learning progress is stored per language, so you can study in multiple languages simultaneously if you want.
faq.a11: Yes, fully open source. The entire codebase is publicly available on GitHub under an open licence. You can inspect the code, suggest improvements, fork it, or build on top of it.
faq.q12: How can I contribute to the project?
faq.a12: There are many ways to contribute: submitting code improvements, writing or translating lessons, reporting bugs, improving documentation, or simply starring the repository on GitHub to help others discover the project. Every contribution matters.
faq.q13: Is AI really hard to learn?
faq.a13: It can seem daunting at first, but it absolutely doesn't have to be. Our programs break complex concepts into clear, digestible lessons using real-world examples, analogies, and interactive experiments. Most learners are surprised by how accessible AI becomes with the right guidance.
faq.q14: How long will it take to learn AI?
faq.a14: You can grasp the fundamentals of AI in a few weeks of consistent, focused study. Becoming truly proficient takes longer, but the journey is rewarding at every stage. Our programs are designed to give you practical, applicable knowledge from day one.
faq.a15: The Lab is a collection of interactive AI experiments you can run live in your browser. no installation or setup required. Explore a neural network playground, test AI vs human text detection, experiment with prompts, generate images, analyse sentiment, chat with an AI, and explore ethics scenarios.
faq.q16: Do I need an account to start learning?
faq.a16: Je hebt geen account nodig om programma's, artikelen en het Lab te bekijken. Probeer de eerste les van elke academie gratis, of maak een account aan om Pro aan te schaffen, voortgang bij te houden op meerdere apparaten en certificaten te verdienen.
faq.a17: Completion certificates are on our roadmap. Currently, the focus is on building genuine understanding and practical skills. When certificates launch, they'll be available free of charge for all completed programs.
faq.q18: How often is new content added?
faq.a18: New lessons, programs, blog articles, and lab experiments are added regularly. The platform is actively maintained and evolves alongside advances in AI technology, so there's always something new to explore.
faq.q19: What AI topics do the programs cover?
faq.a19: Topics include: what AI and machine learning really are, how neural networks work, natural language processing, computer vision, AI ethics and bias, prompt engineering, large language models, and how to apply AI tools effectively in real-world projects.
faq.q20: What is the Craft Engineering path?
faq.a20: The Craft Engineering path focuses on the software engineering skills needed to build AI-powered applications. covering software design principles, clean architecture, reliability engineering, and how to integrate AI models into production-grade systems.
faq.q21: Can I learn on my phone or tablet?
faq.a21: Absolutely! AI Educademy is fully responsive and works beautifully on mobile devices and tablets. It's also a Progressive Web App (PWA), so you can install it on your home screen for a fast, app-like experience. even with limited connectivity.
faq.q22: Is there a community or forum?
faq.a22: Yes! We have a community section where learners connect, share progress, ask questions, and support each other. You're not learning alone. there are fellow learners at every stage of the journey.
faq.q23: How do I track my learning progress?
faq.a23: Progress is tracked automatically as you complete lessons and programs. Sign in or create a guest profile to access your personalised progress dashboard, see your completion stats, and easily resume where you left off.
faq.q24: What makes AI Educademy different from other platforms?
faq.a24: AI Educademy combineert een echte gratis proefles in elke academie met gestructureerd leren, praktische projecten, interactieve experimenten en écht meertalige content. Pro brengt je van de basis naar productiegerichte AI-vaardigheden.
faq.a25: Bekijk de academies en probeer de gratis eerste les van elk programma, of dat nu AI Seeds, AI Canopy of Interview Launchpad is. Kies een maandelijks, jaarlijks of levenslang Pro-abonnement wanneer je klaar bent om de rest te ontgrendelen.

privacy.title: Privacybeleid
privacy.subtitle: Laatst bijgewerkt: maart 2025
privacy.intro: AI Educademy zet zich in voor de bescherming van je privacy. Dit beleid legt uit hoe we je persoonlijke gegevens verzamelen, gebruiken en beschermen.

collect.title: 1. Informatie die we verzamelen
collect.content: We verzamelen: je naam, e-mailadres en profielfoto van je OAuth-provider (Google of GitHub); je leervoortgang en cursusafronding; abonnements- en betalingsgegevens verwerkt door Stripe; gebruiksgegevens waaronder bezochte pagina's en gebruikte functies; apparaat- en browserinformatie voor analyse.

use.title: 2. Hoe we je informatie gebruiken
use.content: We gebruiken je informatie om: de leerervaring te bieden en te personaliseren; je cursusvoortgang te volgen; betalingen te verwerken en abonnementen te beheren; belangrijke account- en servicemeldingen te verzenden; ons platform te verbeteren door middel van analyse; optionele educatieve nieuwsbrieven te verzenden (je kunt je op elk moment afmelden).

sharing.title: 3. Delen van informatie
sharing.content: We verkopen je persoonlijke gegevens niet. We delen gegevens alleen met: Stripe (betalingsverwerking), Resend (e-mailbezorging), Neon (databasehosting), Vercel (hosting) en GitHub/Google (authenticatie). Alle externe providers voldoen aan de AVG.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies en tracking
cookies.content: We gebruiken essentiële cookies voor authenticatie en sessiebeheer. We gebruiken analyses om te begrijpen hoe ons platform wordt gebruikt. We gebruiken geen advertentiecookies en verkopen geen gegevens aan adverteerders.

retention.title: 5. Gegevensbewaring
retention.content: We bewaren je accountgegevens zolang je account actief is. Als je je account verwijdert, verwijderen we je persoonlijke gegevens binnen 30 dagen. Geanonimiseerde analysegegevens kunnen voor onbepaalde tijd worden bewaard. Betalingsgegevens worden bewaard zoals vereist door de Britse belastingwetgeving.

rights.title: 6. Je rechten (AVG)
rights.content: Op grond van de Britse AVG heb je het recht om: toegang te krijgen tot je persoonlijke gegevens; onjuiste gegevens te corrigeren; verwijdering van je gegevens te verzoeken; je gegevens in een draagbaar formaat te exporteren; bezwaar te maken tegen de verwerking van je gegevens; je toestemming op elk moment in te trekken. Om deze rechten uit te oefenen, neem contact met ons op via privacy@aieducademy.org.

security.title: 7. Beveiliging
security.content: We implementeren beveiligingsmaatregelen conform de industriestandaard, waaronder: versleutelde gegevensoverdracht (TLS/SSL), veilige authenticatie via OAuth 2.0, PCI-conforme betalingsverwerking via Stripe, regelmatige beveiligingsbeoordelingen en toegangscontroles op alle systemen.

children.title: 8. Privacy van kinderen
children.content: AI Educademy is niet bedoeld voor kinderen jonger dan 13 jaar. We verzamelen niet bewust persoonlijke gegevens van kinderen jonger dan 13 jaar. Als je denkt dat een kind ons persoonlijke gegevens heeft verstrekt, neem dan onmiddellijk contact met ons op.

international.title: 9. Internationale gegevensoverdrachten
international.content: Je gegevens kunnen worden verwerkt in de EU en de VS via onze hostingproviders. Alle overdrachten worden beschermd door passende waarborgen, waaronder standaardcontractbepalingen waar van toepassing.

changes.title: 10. Wijzigingen in dit beleid
changes.content: We kunnen dit beleid van tijd tot tijd bijwerken. We informeren je per e-mail over belangrijke wijzigingen. Voortgezet gebruik van de dienst na wijzigingen geldt als aanvaarding.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.content: Voor privacygerelateerde vragen: e-mail privacy@aieducademy.org. Vragen over gegevensbescherming kunnen worden gericht aan theglobalmind.ai@gmail.com.

terms.title: Servicevoorwaarden
terms.subtitle: Laatst bijgewerkt: maart 2025
terms.intro: Welkom bij AI Educademy. Door toegang te krijgen tot of gebruik te maken van ons platform, ga je akkoord met deze voorwaarden.

use.title: 1. Gebruik van de dienst
use.content: AI Educademy biedt AI-educatieve inhoud, waaronder cursussen, interactieve labs en leermiddelen. Je mag onze dienst gebruiken voor persoonlijke, niet-commerciële educatieve doeleinden. Je moet minimaal 13 jaar oud zijn om deze dienst te gebruiken.

accounts.title: 2. Gebruikersaccounts
accounts.content: Je kunt inloggen met Google of GitHub OAuth. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de beveiliging van je account. Je moet nauwkeurige informatie verstrekken bij registratie. We behouden ons het recht voor om accounts die deze voorwaarden schenden op te schorten.

subscriptions.title: 3. Abonnementen en betalingen
subscriptions.content: AI Educademy biedt gratis en betaalde abonnementen. Betaalde abonnementen worden veilig verwerkt via Stripe. Maand- en jaarabonnementen worden automatisch verlengd tenzij opgezegd. Je kunt op elk moment opzeggen via je accountdashboard. Terugbetalingen worden per geval afgehandeld binnen 14 dagen na aankoop, in overeenstemming met de Britse consumentenrechten.

content.title: 4. Inhoud en intellectueel eigendom
content.content: Alle cursusinhoud, inclusief teksten, codevoorbeelden, diagrammen en interactieve oefeningen, is intellectueel eigendom van AI Educademy. Gratis inhoud is beschikbaar onder de MIT-licentie waar aangegeven. Premium-inhoud mag niet worden herverdeeld, gekopieerd of gedeeld zonder toestemming.

conduct.title: 5. Aanvaardbaar gebruik
conduct.content: Je stemt ermee in om niet: je accountgegevens te delen, te proberen premium-inhoud te openen zonder geldig abonnement, geautomatiseerde tools te gebruiken om inhoud te scrapen, schadelijke inhoud te uploaden of andere gebruikers lastig te vallen. Overtredingen kunnen leiden tot beëindiging van het account.

disclaimer.title: 6. Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: AI Educademy biedt educatieve inhoud op basis van "zoals het is". Hoewel we streven naar nauwkeurigheid, garanderen we niet dat alle inhoud foutloos of actueel is. AI Educademy is niet verantwoordelijk voor carrièreresultaten of sollicitatiegesprekken.

liability.title: 7. Beperking van aansprakelijkheid
liability.content: Voor zover wettelijk toegestaan, is AI Educademy niet aansprakelijk voor indirecte, incidentele of gevolgschade voortvloeiend uit je gebruik van de dienst. Onze totale aansprakelijkheid bedraagt niet meer dan het bedrag dat je ons hebt betaald in de 12 maanden voorafgaand aan de claim.

changes.title: 8. Wijzigingen in de voorwaarden
changes.content: We kunnen deze voorwaarden van tijd tot tijd bijwerken. Voortgezet gebruik van de dienst na wijzigingen geldt als aanvaarding. We informeren geregistreerde gebruikers per e-mail over belangrijke wijzigingen.

governing.title: 9. Toepasselijk recht
governing.content: Deze voorwaarden worden beheerst door het recht van Engeland en Wales. Geschillen vallen onder de exclusieve bevoegdheid van de rechtbanken van Engeland en Wales.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.content: Voor vragen over deze voorwaarden, neem contact met ons op via support@aieducademy.org.
